The foreground blue mass is indeed amorphous and lacks structural definition, a common AI artifact when generating out-of-focus foreground elements. The Perceptual Quality Auditor found no global distortions (noise/compression), which supports the idea that the issues are localized generation artifacts rather than overall image degradation.
